summary: Conversation main screen. ui/ConversationScreen.kt: for an authorized host AppShell now renders a Scaffold with (top) the switcher button, project title and a horizontally scrollable chip row [Agent|Arch] mode switch, worktree chip (active subtab, opens the switcher drawer) and model chip (host model, opens the model sheet; same 'Inspect host model' description); (middle) a reverse LazyColumn keyed per turn: index 0 is the streaming row (phone prompts and desktop live text, rendered as markdown), then turns newest-first with markdown content and tool calls collapsed to one line (chevron reveals the argument preview; the reader button and truncation markers stay), and last (top) the session controls that have no secondary page yet (connection header, session toolbar, approvals, statuses, task composer, terminal, device actions). It sticks to the bottom: when a turn or the streaming row appears while the reader is at the newest item (checked against the pre-change layout without subscribing to scroll), it scrolls to index 0; a growing streaming row stays anchored by the reverse layout. (bottom) ui/Composer.kt: pinned composer with imePadding/navigationBarsPadding, ImeAction.Send, and one tri-state button: Send (idle), Steer (running + text), Stop (running + empty draft, cancels that message); the draft is the existing saveable Draft. ui/Markdown.kt: dependency-free light markdown (fenced code blocks incl. an open streamed fence, inline code spans, -/*/+ and 1./1) lists with nesting); everything else stays verbatim; code blocks scroll horizontally. Model/resources/files dialogs moved to screen level so they never live inside a lazy item.

notes: Deviations / decisions: (1) Owned paths are ui/ConversationScreen.kt, ui/Markdown.kt, ui/Composer.kt (all new). Also touched: ui/AppShell.kt (hosts ConversationScreen for an authorized host; the pairing / no-project screen is unchanged), ui/ConversationSection.kt (WorkspaceSection keeps only the controls without a secondary page; the old PromptComposer, TranscriptTurns, LiveStreams and model button moved into the owned files), screenshot fixture, new JVM tests, new androidTest ConversationJankTest.kt (the 500-turn validator needs a device) and SessionScopeScreenTest.kt (2 asserts: an empty steering draft now shows Stop instead of a disabled 'Send steering input'). (2) Agent/Arch: the remote protocol has no Arch (master-session console) operation, so Arch is shown disabled ('Desktop only'); no protocol was invented. (3) Stop in the composer is 'Stop message' so it never collides with the per-status 'Cancel message <id>' button. (4) Session controls (connection, toolbar, approvals, statuses, task composer, terminal, device) are the oldest list item until ZE-531/533 move them to the approval strip and secondary pages; the terminal's non-saveable inputs reset if that item scrolls far out of view. (5) The composer area and the chip row are scroll containers (bounded height / horizontal), which also keeps the instrumentation suites' performScrollTo working on composer and model-chip nodes. (6) The worktree and model chips use clearAndSetSemantics with one description so their labels never duplicate tab or model texts. (7) Jank threshold: 'janky' uses the JankStats default (frame > 2 refresh periods); with a 1-refresh threshold the emulator's ~17.4 ms median frame (one vsync plus queueing, even when idle) would count nearly every frame.
